title: Blockwise Online-Softmax Attention
prompt:
Implement `blockwise_attention(Q, K, V, block_size)` with PyTorch for batched single-head attention: `softmax(Q @ K.transpose(-2, -1) / sqrt(d), dim=-1) @ V`.

Assume finite float32/float64 tensors Q `(B, Tq, d)`, K `(B, Tk, d)`, V `(B, Tk, dv)` with matching dtype/device, positive dimensions, and representable scaled dot products. `block_size` is a positive Python integer and may exceed either sequence length. Return `(B, Tq, dv)` with the same dtype/device, preserving gradients to Q/K/V and without mutating inputs. No input validation, mask, or batch broadcasting is required.

Tile both sequence axes in chunks no larger than `block_size`. Merge the per-query running maximum, softmax denominator, and weighted-value numerator with stable online-softmax rescaling. Compute only score tiles of at most `block_size × block_size`; do not materialize a full attention matrix as a separate intermediate or call an attention helper. Match stable dense attention within floating-point tolerance, including gradients. Autograd may save tiles for backward; a custom memory-efficient backward or GPU kernel is not required.

This batched API is a local practice choice; the source report identifies a FlashAttention implementation task and a basic-simulation interpretation.
